purpose: Authoritative GPT visual analysis for early historical references plus an evidence-backed regroup proposal. Semantic analysis is complete for the listed assets. Canonical regrouping is intentionally NOT authorized by this artifact.
semantic_boundary: OBSERVATION means directly visible image content.
Seller/source material names and promotional claims remain source claims only.
No mineral species, authenticity, treatment or geological provenance is confirmed from images.
Presence in Inbox is not USER SIGNAL.
Existing canonical asset/reference moves, splits, rewrites or deletions require separate HIGH_RISK authorization because they change historical canonical grouping.

observations: Large smoky-brown and clear rounds are mixed with one dark rectangular block, one warm patterned round and a small stack of brown disc-like spacers.
The palette stays neutral-to-warm and the design relies on bead-to-bead optical variation rather than bright color.
The compact brown disc cluster creates a small matte-looking interruption among glossy larger units.
semantic_groups.inference: A restrained smoky composition gains identity from a few tactile/geometric interruptions rather than a single dominant hero.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Smoky transparency, one dark block and a compact warm spacer cluster create a quiet mixed-material rhythm.

observations: Warm rust-red translucent rounds dominate the bracelet, interrupted by clear rectangular units, a large smoky oval/round unit and one bright gold-toned sphere.
The major beads remain large and visually weighty, while color and geometry provide the main rhythm changes.
The gold-toned sphere acts as a high-luminance punctuation inside an otherwise earthy transparent palette.
semantic_groups.inference: The design uses one metallic punctuation and clear geometric breaks to sharpen an otherwise warm monochromatic system.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Rust transparency forms the base rhythm; clear blocks and one gold-toned accent create controlled visual punctuation.

observations: A large dark smoky oval is the strongest visual anchor, paired with a few clear/smoky beads and elongated transparent or brown rectangular units.
Most of the circumference is carried by thin silver-toned arc/cord structure instead of a continuous bead strand.
The sparse bead count leaves substantial negative space and makes every large unit visually isolated.
semantic_groups.inference: This is closer to mineral placement on a structural metal line than to a conventional bead bracelet.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Sparse mineral-like units and a large smoky oval are distributed across a thin silver-toned structural arc, making space part of the design.

observations: Large deep-blue glossy rounds form a nearly uniform sequence.
One oversized clear-to-white circular focal with a crescent-like internal/metallic visual motif breaks the blue repetition.
Hardware is minimal and visually subordinate to the saturated blue field.
semantic_groups.inference: A single luminous focal carries most of the design intervention inside an otherwise classical large-round strand.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Uniform deep-blue rounds create calm mass while one pale circular focal acts as the sole high-contrast interruption.

observations: Several large deep-blue rounds occupy one sector, while the opposite side transitions into smaller clear and pale aqua rounds.
Tiny gold-toned spacers punctuate the smaller-bead section without becoming dominant.
The bracelet uses both color lightening and bead-size reduction around the circumference.
semantic_groups.inference: Scale and color move together as a gradient from dense deep blue toward lighter transparent micro-rhythm.
semantic_groups.synthesis: A sector of large blue beads dissolves into smaller clear/aqua beads, creating a directional scale-and-color gradient.

observations: Large clear rounds with visible internal inclusions form the majority of the strand.
One muted blue-gray round and restrained silver-toned separators introduce low-saturation contrast.
Because hue variation is small, internal clarity and inclusion structure remain visually prominent.
semantic_groups.inference: Optical detail carries more identity than color; the gray accent prevents the strand from reading as completely uniform.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Clear inclusion-rich rounds dominate, with one blue-gray interruption and restrained silver transitions.

observations: Very small pale-aqua and clear beads create a fine continuous circumference.
One larger transparent pale-blue circular/oval element is centered as a restrained focal.
Tiny gold-toned spacers create micro-scale highlights rather than visible hardware mass.
semantic_groups.inference: The design expresses delicacy through extreme scale reduction and one slightly enlarged optical focal.
semantic_groups.synthesis: A micro-bead aqua halo is interrupted by one larger transparent focal and minute gold-toned punctuation.

observations: Deep green, black-green and smoky rounds are combined with one large translucent green rectangular block.
Stacks of dark-brown disc-like spacers appear repeatedly and are large enough to function as visible structural transitions.
Ornate silver-toned sculptural components cluster near the rectangular hero and brown spacer stacks.
Multiple views confirm the same asymmetric distribution of green block, dark rounds, brown discs and silver hardware.
semantic_groups.inference: Warm matte-looking brown spacers act as structural texture against glossy dark-green mineral-like units, while silver hardware turns the green block into a focal assembly.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Dark forest tones are organized around a rectangular green hero, repeated brown structural spacer stacks and ornate silver-toned transitions.

observations: This reference is a vertically suspended ornament rather than a wrist bracelet.
Transparent green, smoky, wine-toned and clear bead-like units alternate with ornate silver-toned cages, caps and spacers along one long axis.
A large irregular green-gray slab-like element occupies the lower-middle position as the strongest mineral-like mass.
Small dangling side charms introduce lateral movement from the otherwise vertical composition.
semantic_groups.inference: The reference is useful as a narrative-component and vertical-assembly study: metal grammar and directional sequencing are as important as the mineral-like units.
semantic_groups.synthesis: A long vertical sequence combines varied translucent units, ornate silver hardware and one irregular slab hero into a totem-like hanging composition.

observations: Clear, smoky gray and muted green-gray large rounds are interrupted by transparent rectangular units and dark block-like spacers.
Several tiny dark-teal beads and a small star-like silver charm create micro-scale accents.
The source pairs the bracelet with blue-black ink/water imagery and also shows it suspended alone against a pale interior.
semantic_groups.inference: The strongest design logic is a cool smoky optical field punctuated by dark geometry and very small color/metal accents.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Clear-smoky rounds, rectangular transparent units and dark spacers form a cool geometric rhythm with a small star-like accent.

observations: Large clear rounds alternate with irregular dark-brown chip or disc-like elements around most of the circumference.
A short silver-toned chain with small botanical/charm details hangs from one section.
The contrast is primarily optical and tactile: glossy transparent spheres against rougher-looking warm-brown irregular pieces.
Three source views show the same bracelet in a box, close detail and full-product arrangement.
semantic_groups.inference: The brown irregular pieces function as warm structural texture and keep the clear rounds from reading as a generic transparent strand.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Clear spherical mass is repeatedly interrupted by small warm-brown irregular texture and a restrained silver charm line.

observations: Dark emerald, translucent green, smoky blue-gray and black rounds are mixed with one large green rectangular/cube-like element.
Several conspicuous silver-toned caps, separators and sculptural details interrupt the round sequence.
One clear round with bright internal reflective detail acts as a luminous counterpoint to the darker green field.
Dark-background presentation increases the contrast of green transparency and silver reflections.
semantic_groups.inference: The composition balances forest-dark color with silver hardware and one bright optical bead, producing a denser, more decorative interpretation of the forest palette.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Emerald-to-smoky rounds and a green block are structured by visible silver hardware and one luminous clear counterpoint.

observations: Faceted red-to-rust translucent beads alternate with very dark smoky/black faceted units.
Dark metallic-looking separators and a small padlock-like charm reinforce the black-red contrast.
The product is photographed on a dark textured slab under low-key directional light.
A material-explanation graphic in the source is seller-provided context and is not treated as verified material identity.
semantic_groups.inference: The design reads as compact, rooted and weighty because saturation, faceting and dark metal all concentrate visual density rather than introducing airy transparency.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Faceted red/rust units and near-black geometry form a dense root-like rhythm with dark metal and a small lock-shaped charm.

observations: A large ornate silver-framed oval focal with pale pink/green internal appearance dominates the composition.
The main circumference mixes green-gray rounds, clear rectangular units and silver botanical/sculptural hardware.
A separate fine line of small green beads runs alongside part of the main bracelet, creating a second scale and parallel direction.
Multiple dangling silver details extend beyond the main circumference.
semantic_groups.inference: The piece behaves as a layered focal assembly rather than a single-strand bead bracelet: framed hero, main line, micro-bead secondary line and hanging hardware coexist.
semantic_groups.synthesis: An ornate framed oval hero anchors a layered green-gray composition with clear geometry, silver botanical hardware and a secondary micro-bead line.

observations: A large ornate silver-framed dark green-gray round/oval focal establishes the primary hero.
Green-gray, smoky, clear and red-brown units of several shapes and scales are distributed around the circumference.
Silver-toned botanical, wave-like and framed components are frequent and visually structural.
Dense multi-scale clustering appears near the focal while other sections remain relatively more open.
semantic_groups.inference: High material and hardware complexity is controlled by a clear framed hero and repeated green/red/silver tonal logic rather than by uniform bead shape.
semantic_groups.synthesis: A framed dark-green hero organizes a dense multi-scale green/red/silver composition with botanical and wave-like hardware.

observations: Cream, chalk white, pale gray and very light blue-gray create an extremely low-saturation palette.
Large round elements are interrupted by multiple oversized irregular, rectangular and raw-looking pale pieces.
Visible metal is minimal; form, scale and surface pattern provide most of the design structure.
The seller layout annotates individual components, but those names remain source claims only.
semantic_groups.inference: The piece treats irregular pale mineral-like blocks as architecture inside a soft tonal field, producing geological structure without dark contrast.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Low-saturation pale rounds and oversized irregular blocks create a chalky geological architecture with almost no visible hardware.

observations: A large smoky circular/oval focal is enclosed or capped by ornate silver-toned hardware and dominates the center zone.
Clear-to-smoky beads, dark metal units and silver structural parts create a mostly monochrome dark-gray system.
A secondary chain/bead line runs alongside the principal bracelet body, and multiple dangling silver details extend below it.
Black-background photography emphasizes metallic texture and the dark framed focal.
semantic_groups.inference: The piece uses a gothic relic-like focal plus parallel linework, making silver structure and dangling hardware nearly equal to the mineral-like beads in visual importance.
semantic_groups.synthesis: A dark framed focal, parallel secondary line and ornate silver hardware produce a gothic multi-line bracelet architecture.

observations: Large clear, pale gray and milky-white rounds/irregular forms dominate a very bright cool palette.
Silver-toned floral, snowflake-like and small spacer components are distributed between large transparent units.
A short extension chain and dangling details add a fine linear counterpoint to the large bead mass.
Worn and black-box product views confirm the same airy clear-white composition.
semantic_groups.inference: The design uses high transparency, pale optical variation and delicate silver motifs to create a light snow-like mood without relying on saturated color.
semantic_groups.synthesis: Large clear-white optical units are connected by delicate silver floral/snow-like hardware and a fine extension line.
